headline: Changes to the Management Boards of the Group’s Subsidiaries
summary: Effective 31 July 2026, Kadri Ärm will step down as CEO of Apollo Cinemas Baltics within the Apollo Group OÜ group and will resign from her positions as a member of the Management Board of Apollo Kino OÜ, a wholly owned subsidiary of Apollo Group OÜ, as well as its subsidiaries Apollo Kino SIA (Latvia) and Apollo Kinas UAB (Lithuania).
